title: Zuriel Hebrew and Greek Lexicon Study Index
usageNote: This index supplies lookup keys and study prompts only. Always retrieve the full lemma, senses, transliteration and morphology from the linked lexicon/interlinear source. A Strong's number is an index, not a complete definition. Meanings vary by context; do not assign a lemma to an English word unless the verse-level source alignment verifies it.

entries.contextPrompt: Study how the name is revealed in its narrative and covenant setting. Respect the distinction between the Hebrew name and English translation conventions.

entries.studyLabel: God; gods; divine beings, according to context
entries.contextPrompt: The form and meaning must be interpreted from syntax and context; do not assume the same English rendering in every occurrence.

entries.studyLabel: Steadfast love; covenant loyalty; kindness, according to context
entries.contextPrompt: Explore the relational and covenant setting. No single English gloss captures every use.

entries.studyLabel: Peace; well-being; wholeness, according to context
entries.contextPrompt: Read whether the passage concerns greeting, safety, communal well-being, reconciliation or peace.

entries.studyLabel: Faithfulness; firmness; trustworthiness, according to context
entries.contextPrompt: Compare the passage's emphasis on reliability, faithful conduct or trust; avoid forcing one English gloss.

entries.studyLabel: Truth; reliability; faithfulness, according to context
entries.contextPrompt: Observe whether the word describes truthful speech, dependable character or covenant reliability.

entries.studyLabel: Wind; breath; spirit, according to context
entries.contextPrompt: The word has a broad semantic range. Determine from grammar and context whether wind, breath or spirit is intended.
Study the relationship between knowledge, covenant faithfulness and wise action in the surrounding passage.

entries.studyLabel: Word; message; account, according to context
entries.contextPrompt: Do not assume every occurrence refers to Jesus as a title; examine syntax and literary context.

entries.studyLabel: Love; care or regard, according to context
entries.contextPrompt: Study the action and object of love in context. Avoid simplistic claims that one Greek word always means a uniquely higher kind of love.

entries.studyLabel: Faith; trust; faithfulness, according to context
entries.contextPrompt: Examine whether the passage emphasises trust, belief, faithfulness or a related sense.

entries.studyLabel: Grace; favour; gracious gift, according to context
entries.contextPrompt: Track how grace functions in the argument; distinguish divine favour from the effects it produces.
Determine whether the passage concerns rescue, present deliverance or final salvation.

entries.studyLabel: Spirit; wind; breath, according to context
entries.contextPrompt: Use grammar and context to identify whether the passage refers to the Holy Spirit, human spirit, or wind/breath.
Compare ethical, covenantal and saving dimensions in context; do not flatten the term into one English phrase.

entries.studyLabel: Eternal; belonging to an age, according to context
entries.contextPrompt: Consider the phrase and its contrast in context; avoid building a complete doctrine from an isolated gloss.

entries.studyLabel: Repentance; change of mind and direction
entries.contextPrompt: Read repentance with the call to turn toward God and its observable fruit; avoid reducing it to regret alone.

entries.studyLabel: Spirit; wind; breath, according to context
entries.contextPrompt: Use passage context and source parsing. Duplicate Strong's IDs should be deduplicated in UI lookup results.
